newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Perez Q4 net seen up without inflation.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Perez Q4 net seen up without inflation.

text.p: Argentine conglomerate Perez Companc is expected to report that net earnings in the fourth quarter were slightly lower than the previous year, but higher after discounting inflation, analysts say.
Higher fertilizer revenues, increased gas sales in Argentina and higher oil production in Venezuela were the highlights of the period ended August 31.
The financial results are expected to be released early next week.
"We expect that Perez will report earnings of $65.3 million ($0.087 per share)," said Merchant Bankers, an affiliate of Salomon Brothers.

"Although the net income is lower than that of $68 million of the same period year ago, on a normalized basis this is a stronger quarter," Merchant's head of research Andres Pitchon said in an interview.
Net earnings in the 1995 fourth quarter included a gain of about $10 million for inflation adjustments. No similar item is expected to be applied in the quarter just ended.
He forecast fourth quarter consolidated revenues of $364 million thanks mainly to strong fertilizer sales.
In July, Perez reported $122 million in earnings for the third quarter, including an extraordinary gain of $61 million and net earnings of $263 million for the first nine months.
JP Morgan Securities said it expected Perez to report a "solid results" of $60 million for the fourth quarter.

Its analyst Mary Bourque wrote that "based on our fourth quarter estimate of $0.08 per share, our 1996 estimate (excluding all extraordinary gains accrued in the first three quarters of the year that total $72.6 million) is revised upward to $0.33 per share versus the previous $0.32."
Jay Buthani, of Caspian Securities, expected the company to report net earnings of $60 million for the fourth quarter and $323 million for the year. Perez earned $246 million in all of 1995.
"Although a little weaker than those of third quarter considering lower margins in their petrochemical business in the fourth quarter, results are fairly good," he said.
EPS would be about $0.08 for the quarter and $0.43 for the year, Buthani added.
